primary_title_candidate: Beyond Random Splits: Distribution-Shift-Aware Crop Disease Recognition Across Agricultural Imaging Domains

completed_evidence_gates.calibration: verified on PlantVillage validation/test protocol; shifted-domain calibration remains limited
completed_evidence_gates.uncertainty: Phase 15 submitted and running; results not yet promoted

blocked_or_unavailable_claims: agronomic, yield, pesticide, economic, or deployment benefit
allowed_claim_boundary: The current study can quantify random-split reference performance, laboratory-to-external-domain transfer degradation, calibration on the in-domain protocol, and uncertainty/OOD behavior. It cannot establish early-disease sensitivity or farm/season/cultivar generalization without additional traceable datasets and metadata.
